tool: Built-in image_gen imagegen, through the Codex CLI
prompt: Use case: production sprite atlas for the cozy PlayPets desktop game. ONE CHARACTER IN ONE FIXED OUTFIT: exactly the character in the reference image (same face, markings, outfit, colors and proportions), drawn in its style: fine warm-brown outlines, matte painted color planes, soft gentle shading. Landscape canvas 1536x1024 split into an exact grid of FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows (tiles of 384x512). Each tile holds ONE isolated full-body pose, centered, whole body inside its tile with generous empty margins, feet or seat on a common baseline near the bottom of the tile; nothing crosses into another tile. Fixed three-quarter camera facing right in every tile, head and body drawn at exactly the same scale in every tile. TOP ROW left to right: tile 1 knees bending to sit down, one hand reaching back toward the ground; tile 2 sitting on the ground, legs stretched forward, hands resting on its lap, relaxed smile; tile 3 the same sitting pose with eyes gently closed, content and sleepy; tile 4 standing, both arms raised high above the head in a big happy stretch, feet flat on the ground. BOTTOM ROW left to right: tile 5 standing, a yawn with one hand covering the open mouth, eyes squeezed shut; tile 6 standing, arms lowering after the stretch, pleased smile; tile 7 completely EMPTY; tile 8 standing relaxed and neutral, exactly like the reference. Background: one flat pure white #FFFFFF everywhere, with no shadow, ground patch, haze, texture or vignette. No text, labels, numbers, props, effects, sparkles, frames or borders. <outfitLock>
note: Each sheet was generated once with the common prompt followed by its outfit lock and was reviewed beside the idle cells for identity, outfit, scale and clean edges before packing.
